name: AgentTeams
description: Runs multi-agent teams as a Manager and Workers in Matrix rooms people can join, self-hosted from one command or hosted on Alibaba Cloud.

skills.name: Manager and workers
skills.description: Coordinates worker agents through a manager agent, so people don't have to oversee each worker.

skills.name: Collaboration rooms
skills.description: Puts every task in a Matrix room with you, the manager and the workers, so you can watch and step in.
